cash_breakdown.item: Cash at bank and in hand - RMB
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Main operating subsidiaries are in mainland China and the annual report does not prove rapid upstream dividend availability.
cash_breakdown.reason: Bank cash is fund-like, but mainland ownership and distribution path are not fully disclosed.

cash_breakdown.item: Cash at bank and in hand - USD
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: USD bank cash is more likely offshore or financing-proceeds related, but parent-level distributable reserve was unavailable at year-end.
cash_breakdown.reason: Can potentially support buybacks, debt repayment or restructuring, but not treated as fully distributable.

cash_breakdown.item: Cash at bank and in hand - HKD and SGD
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Offshore currency cash has better extraction path than mainland cash, offset by no parent distributable reserves and incomplete entity split.
Payment institution balances are tied to operating collections and settlement rather than proven surplus cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Conservatively retained for normal course operations.

cash_breakdown.item: Current USD term deposits over three months
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Current term deposits are short-term and close to market rates.

cash_breakdown.item: Non-current RMB term deposits over three months
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Non-current RMB term deposits are over one year or otherwise non-current, with mainland and timing uncertainty.
cash_breakdown.reason: Deposit asset but less immediately peelable.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: FVTPL wealth management products carry product and fair-value risk; not equivalent to cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Financial products are potentially sellable but not risk-free.

cash_breakdown.item: Other financial assets at amortised cost
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Short-term notes and other investments have guaranteed returns but are not cash and counterparty/liquidity detail is limited.
cash_breakdown.reason: Potentially detachable financial assets at amortised cost.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Annual report states no outstanding bank loans or other borrowings at 2024 year-end.
About 1.8 months of 2024 cash operating cost retained for training centers, instructors, marketing, R&D and working-capital volatility.
cash_breakdown.reason: Detaching this cash would impair continuing operations.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Refund liabilities represent customer refund rights for course fees.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash corresponding to expected refunds is not peelable.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: 50% of prepaid unsatisfied course obligations retained as a conservative fulfilment cost reserve.
cash_breakdown.reason: Prepaid course fees require future service delivery.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Ordinary leases for continued operations are not mechanically deducted from detachable cash; they are reflected in operating cash flow and profit quality.
cash_breakdown.reason: Continuation basis rather than liquidation or closure basis.

profit_quality.assessment: The main denominator uses 2024 operating cash flow less PPE and intangible purchases. Two-year cash generation is positive, but 2024 was much weaker than 2023 because payables and refund liabilities fell, and 2022 free cash flow was negative. Revenue also declined in 2024 under intensified competition.
adjustments: Started from 2024 net operating cash flow of CNY 290,958,000.
Deducted 2024 purchases of property, plant and equipment of CNY 18,311,000 and intangible assets of CNY 2,906,000.
Used CNY 269,741,000 as pre-haircut distributable cash profit.
Applied a 0.70 profit haircut for education refund obligations, declining 2024 revenue, working-capital outflow and limited three-year stability.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2024 FCF after capex was CNY 269.7m; 2023 was CNY 531.6m; 2022 was CNY -120.1m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is acceptable in 2024, but the business carries prepaid-course refund obligations, falling enrollments and material working-capital swings.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2024 operating cash flow / reported net profit was about 1.13x, but partly after adding back non-cash share-based payments and with negative changes in payables/refund liabilities.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: No maintenance/growth split disclosed; 2024 PPE plus intangible purchases of CNY 21.2m are used as a conservative maintenance proxy.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital reduced cash mainly through lower trade and other payables, lower refund liabilities, inventory build and lower contract liabilities.

limitations: Cash is not split by parent company, offshore subsidiaries, mainland operating subsidiaries or VIE/contractual arrangement entities.
Company-level distributable reserves were nil at 2024 year-end, so dividend extraction cannot be assumed even though buybacks occurred during 2024.
Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; total PPE and intangible purchases are used.
Market cap is the historical screen value from 2025-05-28, not current market value.
The education model has prepaid course fees and refund rights; cash corresponding to those obligations is retained rather than treated as peelable.
